business_summary: Qingdao Hanhe Cable Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, production, and sale of cables and wires in China. It offers power cables, bare wires, equipment cables, special cables, data cables, overhead lines, cable accessories, submarine cables, heat resistant and high strength aluminum alloy wires, fire-resistant and armored cables, and DC series cables. It also engages in cable development and research services; and manufacturing and sales of power testing equipment. In addition, it is involved in production and sales of electrical round aluminum poles and materials; overhead stranded wires; distribute electric wires and cables; design, consulting, and technical services for power transmission and transformation projects; electrical and civil engineering, construction, and equipment installation; manufacturing of new energy power equipment; battery manufacturing and sales; information consulting services; software development and sales; technology development, consulting, exchange, transfer, and promotion; sells recycle wooden wheels and industrial waste metals; production and manufacturing of high and low voltage electrical equipment and related materials; solar energy appliance accessories; manufacturing and sales of polar cable materials, equipment-grade components, thermoplastic low-smoke halogen-free flame-retardant cable materials, and radiation cross-linked cable materials; manufactures and sales of graphite, graphene, synthetic, rubber, and carbon products; operation, maintenance and technical consulting of overhead lines and substations; sales of automobiles and auto parts, and rental of owned houses and cars; sales of building materials, daily necessities, office supplies and equipment, and consumables; and sales of mechanical equipment. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Qingdao, China. Qingdao Hanhe Cable Co.,Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Qingdao Hanhe Group Co., Ltd.
business_summary_ko: Qingdao Hanhe Cable Co.,Ltd는 자회사와 함께 중국에서 케이블 및 전선의 개발, 생산, 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 전력 케이블, 나선, 장비 케이블, 특수 케이블, 데이터 케이블, 가공선, 케이블 액세서리, 해저 케이블, 내열 및 고강도 알루미늄 합금 전선, 내화 및 장갑 케이블, DC 시리즈 케이블을 제공합니다. 또한 케이블 개발 및 연구 서비스에도 참여합니다. 전력시험장비 제조 및 판매 등을 하고 있습니다. 또한 전기 원형 알루미늄 기둥 및 재료의 생산 및 판매에도 참여하고 있습니다. 머리 위 연선; 전선 및 케이블을 배포합니다. 송전 및 변전 프로젝트를 위한 설계, 컨설팅 및 기술 서비스; 전기 및 토목 공학, 건축, 장비 설치; 신에너지 전력 장비 제조; 배터리 제조 및 판매; 정보 컨설팅 서비스; 소프트웨어 개발 및 판매; 기술개발, 컨설팅, 교환, 이전 및 홍보; 재활용 나무 바퀴와 산업 폐기물 금속을 판매합니다. 고·저압 전기기기 및 관련 매트의 생산 및 제조
